briarway_is_approach.title: The Briarway Is an Approach
briarway_is_approach.text: The forest is not a dungeon proper. It is the living approach to a mortal threshold built over Balor's prison.

balor_suppressed.title: A Suppression, Not an Ending
balor_suppressed.text: Balor's defeat lowers the prison's pressure. It does not erase the prisoner or repair the failing system that contains him.

first_fall.title: The Hearth Has Fallen Before
first_fall.text: When the Hearth was destroyed, the world folded back around the Keeper's memory. Adventurers did not return with it.

moonlit_counterexample.title: The Moonlit Counterexample
moonlit_counterexample.text: Not every power beyond the seals behaves like an enemy. The official history confuses danger, difference, and guilt.

abyssal_record.title: The Archive's Contradiction
abyssal_record.text: The oldest surviving records disagree with the gods' public account of who designed the prisons and why direct divine intervention is now limited.

divine_promises.title: Promises Bind Both Ways
divine_promises.text: A boon is not a talent purchased from a tree. It is a witnessed exchange whose fulfillment—or breach—changes a divine relationship.
